inspiration: Four soldier stat tracks: health, attack, defense and evade each have a base value, a per-level step and a max level, and one icon per level (data/tribes/workers/barbarians/soldier/init.lua 94-141; icons health_level0-3, attack_level0-5, evade_level0-2). A veteran is readable as four icon ladders above the unit.

Battle clips split by result and direction: attack success and failure, and evade success and failure, each as its own sprite sheet with directions (soldier/init.lua 94-163; sheets atk_ok_*, atk_fail_*, eva_ok_*, eva_fail_*). The player reads hit or miss from the clip, not from a number.

Battle clip picked at random from the variants with the game-logic random source (src/logic/map_objects/tribes/soldier.cc line 228): the pick is deterministic per tick, which fits our replay rule (parity row 19).

Defense and evade are percentages (soldier.cc 965-966 debug print), with evade = base plus level step (soldier.cc 465-466). A chance-to-avoid stat that reads as a percent is easy to show on a HUD card.

Critter sprites: 16 animal folders, each with an idle frame and six walk-direction frames (east, north-east, north-west, south-east, south-west, west), plus a menu icon (data/world/critters/<animal>/). A small idle and walk set per creature covers ambient life cheaply.

Sound manifest: one row per sound with its usage, author, licence and source, plus a note that empty 3.6 kB files lower a sound's play chance (data/sound/wl-sound-docu.csv lines 1-4 and the note at line 2). Weighted silence is a cheap way to vary ambience.
Each soldier descriptor has a fixed list of icon files per level, read by pattern at load (init.lua 115-138). Level icons are data, not code.

briefs.label: Four-track veteran
briefs.why: A unit that improves on four visible tracks reads as a veteran from across the field.
briefs.keep: four stat tracks with a base, a step per level and a max level; one icon per level; icons loaded by pattern from the unit folder
briefs.change: our tracks are guard, stamina, crit and reach, not health and attack; icons are a rune ladder, not stripes; a veteran gets a glow rim instead of a badge

briefs.label: Win-or-lose strike clip
briefs.why: A clip that differs for a hit and for a miss tells the player the result before any number appears.
briefs.keep: separate clip for success and failure; one set per direction; short clip length
briefs.change: one attack clip with a result glyph and a hitstop instead of separate sheets (saves art); the miss shows a dust curl, not a sprite swap

briefs.label: Grazer at the edge
briefs.why: A small herd animal that idles and walks in six listed directions makes a field feel alive for almost no cost.
briefs.keep: an idle frame and six walk-direction frames (east, north-east, north-west, south-east, south-west, west); a menu icon; one folder per creature
briefs.change: a six-legged moor grazer with a horned crest instead of an antlered deer; idle includes a head-up bob; we add a flee clip
briefs.ref: data/world/critters/deer/ and data/world/critters/badger/ (file listing only; init.lua not read)

briefs.label: Silent pool
briefs.why: A sound pool where some entries are silent makes repeats rarer without new audio.
briefs.keep: silent entries in a pool lower the chance of a sound playing; the silent file is a short fixed-size stub
briefs.change: apply the rule to our ambience only; name the silent entry 'rest' in our manifest; the pool gets a per-biome weight
